verdicts.title: Adaptive Lower Bound for Testing Monotonicity on the Line
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:

verdicts.title: Subsumption-driven clause learning with DPLL+restarts
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We propose to use a DPLL+restart to solve SAT instances by successive simplifications based on the production of clauses that subsume the initial clauses.
